title.rendered: Kiierr Daily Super Hair Growth Collagen

content.rendered:
Kiierr Collagen Peptide Powder

Physician Formulated with ALL the Ingredients YOU NEED to SUPERCHARGE Hair Growth!

Collagen plays a role in the structure and strength of hair and nails. Consuming collagen powder may help enhance the health and appearance of both. 

Protein boost: Can be added to smoothies, shakes, or baked goods to increase the protein content without altering the taste or texture significantly.
Thickening agent: Used as a natural thickening agent in soups, stews, and sauces, providing a smoother texture
Gelatin substitute: Used as a substitute for gelatin in recipes like homemade gummies, puddings, or desserts.
Coffee or tea enhancer: Can be added to coffee or tea to enhance their nutritional profile and add a creamy texture without altering the taste.
Protein bars and energy balls: Can be incorporated into homemade protein bars, energy balls, or granola bars for a convenient and nutritious snack option.

*Collagen can boost your hair health in several important ways.

  1. Collagen can be used as an antioxidant to help fight off nasty free radicals harmful to your hair follicles.
  2. Collagen contributes to the structure, elasticity and strength your dermis which contains your hair follicle.
  3. Studies like this one prove that collagen can help improve the skin/dermis/hair follicle and in turn reduce signs of aging.
  4. Collagen may be able to use its antioxidant properties to fight against premature and age related grey hair. Source

Also check out our DHT blocking shampoo, Conditioner for Hair Growth, Omega 369 For Hair Growth and Biotin Gummies to add to your hair growth supplement routine.
